items.example: Oh my God! You got the job!
items.simple: A thing you say when you are very surprised.
dialogue: A: I just got a call from the office.
B: Oh my God! You got the job!
items.note: Friends ve The Big Bang Theory'de her bölümde duyulur.

items.example: Hey, what's up? You look happy.
items.simple: A friendly hello. You ask how someone is or what is new.
dialogue: A: Oh, hi Sam!
B: Hey, what's up? You look happy.
items.note: Dizilerde selam yerine çok sık; cevap: "Not much."

items.simple: You say this when you cannot believe something.
dialogue: A: I met the singer at the shop today.
B: No way! You met him?
items.note: How I Met Your Mother ve Friends'te çok sık.

items.example: Are you serious? It's only eight o'clock!
items.simple: You ask this when you think the other person is joking.
dialogue: A: We have to leave the party now.
B: Are you serious? It's only eight o'clock!
items.note: Hemen her dizide; şaşkınlık veya kızgınlık.

items.example: I'm kidding. Your hair looks great.
items.simple: You say this when your words were a joke, not true.
dialogue: A: Your hair looks terrible!
B: I'm kidding. Your hair looks great.
items.note: The Office ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da sık; "Just kidding" da denir.

items.simple: A short way to say you are surprised or annoyed.
dialogue: A: The bus is late today too.
B: Seriously? Again?
items.note: Modern Family'de sinirli/alaycı tonda sık.

items.simple: You say this to ask if something is true.
dialogue: A: Pizza was invented in Italy, you know.
B: Really? I didn't know that.
items.note: Ton değişince alaycı da olur; her dizide.

items.simple: You say this when you do not care or you give up.
dialogue: A: Should we watch a movie or play a game?
B: Whatever. Do what you want.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'da gençler çok kullanır; biraz kaba.

items.example: Gross! There's hair in my soup.
items.simple: You say this about something dirty or yucky.
dialogue: A: What is wrong with your dinner?
B: Gross! There's hair in my soup.
items.note: Friends ve Malcolm in the Middle'da çok sık.

items.example: Awesome! We're going to the beach.
items.simple: A big word for something very good.
dialogue: A: Guess what? The trip is on for Saturday.
B: Awesome! We're going to the beach.
items.note: The Big Bang Theory ve HIMYM'de çok sık.

items.simple: A short way to say OK or good.
dialogue: A: Dinner is at seven, okay?
B: Cool. See you at seven.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da sık; kısa onay.

items.simple: You say this when the answer is very easy to see.
dialogue: A: Do you like pizza?
B: Do I like pizza? Duh.
items.note: Friends ve Malcolm in the Middle'da; biraz alaycı.

items.simple: You say this when you make a small mistake.
dialogue: A: What was that noise?
B: Oops! I dropped your phone.
items.note: Her dizide; küçük kazalar için.

items.simple: You say this when something hurts you.
dialogue: A: Sorry, I stepped on your shoe.
B: Ouch! That hurt my foot.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'da kardeş kavgalarında sık.

items.example: Yikes! That is a big spider.
items.simple: A short word when something looks bad or scary.
dialogue: A: Look at the wall behind you.
B: Yikes! That is a big spider.
items.note: Modern Family ve Friends'te sık.

items.example: Jeez! Do you have to shout?
items.simple: You say this when you are annoyed or surprised.
dialogue: A: WHERE ARE MY KEYS?
B: Jeez! Do you have to shout?
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle ve The Office'te sık.

items.simple: You say this when something is sad but not very big.
dialogue: A: I have bad news about tonight.
B: Bummer. The party is cancelled.
items.note: The Big Bang Theory ve HIMYM'de gündelik.

items.example: My bad. I forgot your name.
items.simple: A quick way to say you made a mistake.
dialogue: A: Hey, my name is Kate, not Katie.
B: My bad. I forgot your name.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da çok sık; samimi özür.

items.simple: You say this when you feel the same as the other person.
dialogue: A: I need a long sleep.
B: Same here. I'm tired too.
items.note: Her dizide; kısa katılma.

items.simple: You say this to agree strongly.
dialogue: A: Did you love that movie too?
B: Totally. That movie was great.
items.note: Friends ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da sık.

items.example: Nice one! You found my keys.
items.simple: You say this when someone does something good or funny.
dialogue: A: Here are your keys. They were in the sofa.
B: Nice one! You found my keys.
items.note: Britanya'da daha yaygın; HIMYM'de de duyulur.

items.simple: You say this when a joke is not nice.
dialogue: A: Boo! Ha ha, you jumped!
B: Not funny. You scared me.
items.note: Friends ve Modern Family'de kardeş/arkadaş arasında.

items.example: Good for you! You passed the test.
items.simple: You say this when you are happy that something good happened to someone.
dialogue: A: I passed my driving test today.
B: Good for you! You passed the test.
items.note: Bazen alaycı söylenir; ton önemli.

items.simple: A word for something boring or not cool.
dialogue: A: How was the party last night?
B: That party was lame.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle ve The Big Bang Theory'de.

items.example: Shut up! You won a car?
items.simple: Friends say this to show big surprise. It can also mean "be quiet".
dialogue: A: I have big news for you.
B: Shut up! You won a car?
items.note: Friends'te şaşkınlık; kaba da olabilir, dikkat.
